About April · April Johnson

Meet April Johnson, REALTOR®

You should feel comfortable asking your real estate agent a question, including the one you think you should already know the answer to.

I'm April Johnson with 1st Class Real Estate Excellence. I am licensed in Alabama and Georgia and work with buyers and sellers throughout East Alabama and West Georgia.

Talk with April ↗

A personal approach to real estate

My work is about helping you understand your options. Whether you are buying a first home, preparing to sell or considering an investment, I want you to feel informed about the decisions in front of you.

That means listening to what you need, explaining the process and making room for questions. Your timeline, concerns and priorities belong in the conversation from the beginning.

Experience that shapes how I work

Military service and relocation

I am a U.S. Army veteran and hold the Military Relocation Professional certification. My military background informs my commitment to communication, attention to detail and following through.

I understand that relocation can involve uncertainty. Learn more about my military relocation services.

Education and property presentation

I hold a master's degree in Acquisition Management. I also have an interest in interior design and staging, which informs the way I discuss property presentation with sellers and possibilities with buyers.

Tell me what you need from your agent ↗

Buying and selling deserve equal attention

I help buyers find a property and work through the purchasing process. I also help sellers with pricing, marketing strategies and negotiations. Explore buying with April or planning your sale.

My practice includes land, investment properties and new construction within my service markets.

Beyond real estate

Outside work, I enjoy time with family and friends, volunteering in my community, working out and reading about market trends.
